svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Active and Semantic SLAM: research map
svg.desc: Maps that carry meaning and uncertainty. Sub-problems: Semantic data association (Which observation belongs to which object?); Uncertainty-aware maps (How far can the robot trust its pose and map?); Lifelong mapping (Which objects stay, and which have moved?); Active exploration (Where should the robot look next?). Open questions: Calibrated beliefs over geometry and meaning together; Maps that stay correct over weeks, not minutes; Choosing views that reduce semantic uncertainty.
